name: What is AKN Design Group's process for selecting and installing interior doors?

mainEntity.name: What is AKN Design Group's process for selecting and installing interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with understanding your vision and functional needs during the design planning phase. We guide you through material and style options that complement your overall renovation, providing CAD-supported layouts for clarity. Once selections are finalized, our skilled team manages the procurement, site preparation, and professional installation, including frame adjustments and hardware fitting. This integrated design-build approach ensures that your new interior doors are not just installed, but seamlessly integrated into your home's enhanced aesthetics and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves design planning, material selection, and professional installation, ensuring seamless integration of new doors into your home's renovation.
